recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the Bundle example prose is revisited, handle it as a separate issue against the current _count semantics rather than as an unapplied FHIR-17047 change.
issue_request: FHIR-17047 was a Published FHIR-core/FHIR-core-Feed change request raised against STU3. It requested adding _count=1 to the Bundle example self URL, but the accepted Persuasive with Modification resolution specified _count should be 2 because the Bundle says there were 3 matches and only two items appear in the Bundle.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn revision 14366, represented in git as 1ba46476a8ef907374826dd71b9fa50b9157aea4 (GF#17047 - adjust self link in example). That commit added &_count=2 to source/bundle/bundle-example.xml, and the current active source still has that value.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-13174 clarified that _count excludes _include/_revinclude and OperationOutcome resources, and FHIR-32017 later corrected the current search page wording to entry.search.mode = match. That context argues against mechanically changing the XML comment that says the example returns the first 1 result under FHIR-17047, because included resources are not counted by _count. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant community evidence changing the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the resolved self link already says &_count=2 and additional wording cleanup would belong to a separate search-pagination/editorial review.
